verdict.rationale: Consent tooling is a fair question for a meeting recorder, but the evidence pack never documents participant recording notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency settings. What it does show is adjacent and earns no credit: a choice of bot or bot-free capture, a custom meeting bot, admin view permissions, SSO/SCIM provisioning, and API/webhook access.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF
